newsitem.title: UK: S&P affirms Equitable Life AA financial strength.
newsitem.headline: S&P affirms Equitable Life AA financial strength.

text.p: Standard and Poor's credit rating agency said on Monday it had affirmed the AA financial strength rating of Britain's Equitable Life Assurance Society (ELAS).

S&P said in a statement the rating was based on ELAS's leadership of the UK pensions market, a position which it said the firm was well placed to maintain given its "superior expense control and efficient operations".
"The company has accepatble capitalisation supported by strong bonus disciplines," S&P said. "Financial flexibility is, however, considered limited."
Among major rating factors, S&P pointed to ELAS's moves to diversify with small operations in Ireland, Germany and Guernsey, and its share in Permanent Insurance, a healthcare provider.
S&P aslo said that ELAS's direct salesforce distribution, its clear strategy in regard to bonuses and its acceptable capitalisation were important elements behind the AA financial strength rating.
